summary: Created schema; checked all 4 sources are reachable via Chrome; pilot rows for Pumpkin only (item, seed item, crop, season, image URL). No bulk data collected yet.

Imported 10 crops + seeds from wiki_official via scripts/import_crops.py (Pumpkin, Parsnip, Melon, Cauliflower, Ancient Fruit, Cranberries, Blueberry, Strawberry, Sunflower, Fairy Rose): item, crop, crop_season, shop_price (Pierre/Joja), image (pending). All verified=false. fetch_wiki.py now uses curl transport.
Removed crop.giant_crop (owner decision: not used by the app). schema_version 1 -> 2.

schema_version 2 -> 3 (item_season, item_location, animal, monster). Full import of all app categories from wiki_official (2,002/2,004 pages; 'Special Charm' and 'Special Items & Powers' blocked by wiki firewall) + SVE from wiki_sve as content_pack='sve'. Owner exclusions via data/exclude.json: all Joja (items, JojaMart prices, Joja events/buildings) and SVE wiki style-guide pages. Images: 1,118 downloaded (wiki.gg uses flat /images/ paths). All verified=false.
schema_version 3 -> 4: game_constant table (sprinkler reach incl. Pressure Nozzle, Coop/Barn capacity per level, greenhouse plots) via scripts/import_constants.py, parsed from wiki text.

schema_version 4 -> 5: profession table (30 professions, all 5 skills, bonus_kind/bonus_value for price/growth multipliers) via scripts/import_skills.py; game_constant gains crop-quality formula coefficients, fertilizer levels and quality price multipliers; shop_price gains Basic/Quality Fertilizer at Pierre's. import_nature.py animal parser fixed (produce/deluxe items and produce_days).

schema_version 5 -> 6: building gains size_w/size_h (Carpenter's Shop / Wizard's Tower size columns) and upgrade_from (Barn/Coop/Shed page 'Upgrades From' row); Wizard buildings build_days=0 ('require no build time'). npc gains home (villager infobox address). New table npc_schedule (regular + rain day per season) via scripts/import_schedules.py. image img_map_world (File:Map.png, in-game map from Player Menu page) via scripts/import_maps.py.

schema_version 6 -> 7: npc_schedule gains location_th/note_th filled by scripts/import_schedules.py from data/npc_schedule_th.json (owner's Thai glossary, 283 strings). game_constant gains gift_points_love/like/neutral/dislike/hate, gift_birthday_mult and friendship_points_per_heart parsed from the Friendship page (scripts/import_skills.py).

Icons for every app icon slot via new scripts/import_icons.py (data/image.icons.json, 158 rows): img_map_sve (SVE Pelican Town map), img_building_*/img_npc_*/img_animal_* (building/npc/animal.image_id now set by the owning importers via wikitext.icon_ids()), quality/season/weather/skill/profession icons, img_greenhouse, img_ginger_island. Shipping Bin has no PNG in cache (gif only). No schema change.

schema_version 8: new tables location (SVE Locations page, category = page heading, sort = page order, img_loc_<slug> pictures) and location_alias (fish.locations spellings -> location.id), via new scripts/import_locations.py (data/{location,location_alias,image,entity_source}.locations.json). Extra rows Junimo Woods, Henchman's Backyard from their own pages. Pelican Town / Cindersap Forest / Secret Woods rows are content_pack vanilla.

schema_version 9: new tables special_order (18 town-board Special Orders) and special_order_target (65 rows: items/monsters/categories to deliver, one_of + season for choose-one lists) from the wiki Quests page rev 195566, via new scripts/import_special_orders.py (data/{special_order,special_order_target,entity_source}.special_orders.json). Qi's orders and SVE orders not included.

schema_version 10: new table npc_romance (marriage candidates, bachelor/bachelorette). 12 vanilla rows from wiki Marriage page rev 195328 via scripts/import_romance.py; 7 SVE rows set by the owner (source='owner') because the SVE wiki does not split them.

Monster icons: new scripts/import_monster_icons.py writes img_<monster> rows (first PNG in Infobox monster, else '<Title>.png' / '<Title> Dangerous.png'); import_nature.py now also reads image.monsters.json so monster.image_id is set; downloaded 57 of 65 (missing: Slimes and the SVE monsters). No schema change.

Forage seasons/locations: wikitext.seasons_in now reads a plain 'All' (official + SVE infoboxes write it), so Cactus Fruit, Cave Carrot, Coconut, Ginger, Purple Mushroom, Seaweed, Conch, Shark Tooth get all 4 seasons; import_sve.py now writes item_location from the SVE item infobox 'Location' field (Conch, Four Leaf Clover, Mushroom Colony, Poison Mushroom, Rafflesia, Sand Dollar, Shark Tooth). No schema change.
exclude.json: drop Weeds Composite and Wild Grass Screenshot (wiki image pages imported as items), owner request.

schema_version 11: new table place_icon (name_en -> image_id) for 'where to find' names with no item/monster/location row. scripts/import_place_icons.py: 11 wiki files downloaded as img_place_* (Copper Pan, Garbage Can, Frost Jelly, Meteorite, Mystery Box, Supply Crate, two statues, Farm Cave, Trout Derby, Volcano Dungeon) + activity names mapped to existing skill icons.
